    def split_part(self, parent: dict, part: dict, after: list[str]) -> dict:
        """One approved part as a job of its own, linked to the original."""
        repo = self.repo(parent)
        details = {**(parent.get("details") or {}), "criteria": part["criteria"]}
        child = new_job(parent["requester"], parent["repo"], repo, part["request"],
                        {"title": part["title"], "overrides": parent.get("overrides") or {}})
        shots = (parent.get("details") or {}).get("screenshots") or []
        if shots:
            import shutil
            source, target = store.request_dir(parent["id"]), store.request_dir(child["id"])
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            for shot in shots:
                if (source / shot["file"]).is_file():
                    shutil.copyfile(source / shot["file"], target / shot["file"])
        child.update(details=details, parent=parent["id"], after=after,
                     state="blocked" if after else "queued")
        store.save(child)
        store.trace("trace.constraints.snapshot", child["id"], requester=child["requester"],
                    parent=parent["id"], constraints=child["constraints"])
        store.log(child["id"], f"part of {parent['id']}: {parent['title']}")
        store.audit(parent["requester"], "submit", job=child["id"], repo=parent["repo"],
                    title=child["title"], parent=parent["id"])
        return child

    def unblock(self, job: dict) -> int:
        """A part waits until every part it follows has landed, so it starts
        from a base that already has them."""
        waiting = [store.load(j) or {} for j in job.get("after") or []]
        if any(w.get("state") in ("failed", "stopped", "closed") for w in waiting):
            # Asked once; the tick sees it on every pass after.
            if (job.get("needs") or {}).get("kind") != "stuck":
                self.note(job, "a part this one follows will not land; it waits for a person")
                self.move(job, job["stage"], "blocked",
                          needs={"kind": "stuck", "text": "A part this one follows was stopped or failed, "
                                 "so this one cannot start on top of it.", "actions": ["stop"], "at": store.now()})
            return 0
        if all(w.get("state") == "landed" for w in waiting):
            self.note(job, "every part it follows has landed; queued to start")
            self.move(job, job["stage"], "queued", needs=None)
            return 1
        return 0

    def track(self, job: dict) -> int:
        """The original of a split lands when every part has."""
        parts = [store.load(j) or {} for j in job.get("children") or []]
        if parts and all(p.get("state") == "landed" for p in parts):
            self.note(job, "every part has landed")
            self.move(job, "split", "landed")
            return 1
        return 0

    def do_discover(self, job: dict) -> None:
        self.start_turn(job, "discover", briefs.discover(job))

    def after_discover(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        found = parse.discovery(parse.json_block(reply))
        if found is None:
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "discover", "the discovery was not the JSON asked for",
                                      reply)
        job["discovery"] = found
        if found["questions"]:
            self.move(job, "clarify", "needs_you",
                      needs={"kind": "questions", "text": found["summary"],
                             "actions": ["answer", "stop"], "at": store.now()})
            self.note(job, f"{len(found['tasks'])} task(s), {len(found['questions'])} question(s)")
        else:
            self.note(job, f"{len(found['tasks'])} task(s), no questions")
            self.move(job, "plan")

    def retry_or_need(self, job: dict, stage: str, why: str, reply: str) -> None:
        retries = job.setdefault("turn_retries", {})
        retries[stage] = retries.get(stage, 0) + 1
        if retries[stage] <= 1:
            self.note(job, f"{why}; asking again")
            self.move(job, stage, "ready")
        else:
            self.need(job, "stuck", f"{why}.\n\nWhat came back:\n\n{reply[:4000]}", ["retry", "stop"])

    # plan

    def do_plan(self, job: dict) -> None:
        brief = briefs.plan(job)
        if job.get("plan_feedback"):
            brief += ("\n\n## The previous plan was sent back\n\n"
                      f"{job.get('plan', '')}\n\n**What the reviewer said:** {job['plan_feedback']}\n\n"
                      "Revise the plan to address that.")
        self.start_turn(job, "plan", brief)

    def after_plan(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        if self.interrupted(job, reply, "plan"):
            return
        job["plan"] = reply.strip()[:40000]
        job["plan_feedback"] = ""
        job["footprint"] = parse.footprint(reply)
        # The plan is approved before anything is built, the checks included:
        # they are the build's first work (decided 2026-10-24).
        self.ask_approval(job, "The plan is ready for your approval.")

    def checks_ready(self, job: dict, summary: str) -> None:
        """The acceptance tests, written as chosen and failing first (red): on
        to the build. The person chose them before they were written."""
        job["checks_summary"] = summary[:20000]
        self.note(job, "the acceptance tests are written, and each fails before the change: building")
        self.move(job, "implement")

    # define — the acceptance criteria and their scenarios, chosen by the requester

    def do_define(self, job: dict) -> None:
        self.start_turn(job, "define", briefs.define(job))

    def after_define(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        if self.interrupted(job, reply, "define"):
            return
        own = [str(c).strip() for c in (job.get("details") or {}).get("criteria") or [] if str(c).strip()]
        found = parse.definitions(parse.json_block(reply), own)
        if found is None:
            job["define_feedback"] = ("The reply was not the JSON asked for: every criterion"
                                      + (" the requester gave, by its number," if own else ",")
                                      + " with at least one Given/When/Then scenario.")
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "define", "the acceptance tests were not defined as asked", reply)
        job["define_feedback"] = ""
        job["definitions"] = found
        job["criteria_given"] = bool(own)
        self.note(job, f"acceptance tests defined: {sum(len(d['scenarios']) for d in found)} scenario(s) "
                       f"for {len(found)} criteria ({'the requester' + chr(39) + 's' if own else 'proposed'})")
        self.ask_definitions(job)

    def ask_definitions(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """Put the scenarios to the person: which to implement, and what to change."""
        lines = [("The requester's acceptance criteria" if job.get("criteria_given")
                  else "Acceptance criteria proposed for this request") + ", and scenarios for each. Choose the "
                 "ones to implement as acceptance tests, or send them back with a note."]
        for d in job.get("definitions") or []:
            lines += ["", f"**{d['criterion']}** {d['text']}" + (f" (`@{d['layer']}`)" if d.get("layer") else "")]
            lines += [f"- {s['id']}: " + " ".join(re.sub(r"^(Given|When|Then|And|But)\b", r"**\1**", part.strip(), flags=re.I)
                                                 for part in s["text"].splitlines() if part.strip())
                      for s in d["scenarios"]]
        self.move(job, "your_checks", "needs_you",
                  needs={"kind": "checks", "text": "\n".join(lines)[:20000], "actions": ["write", "redefine", "stop"],
                         "at": store.now()})

    def choose_checks(self, actor: str, job_id: str, chosen: list[str], note: str = "",
                      action: str = "write") -> dict:
        """The person's answer to the definitions. `write`: the scenarios they
        kept are the acceptance tests, and the criteria with one kept are the
        contract (numbered again, in order); the next turn writes them. A
        criterion with none kept is not this change's. `redefine`: back to the
        define turn with their note (bounded)."""
        job = self.load(job_id)
        if job.get("state") != "needs_you" or (job.get("needs") or {}).get("kind") != "checks":
            raise Refused("this job is not waiting on its acceptance tests")
        definitions = job.get("definitions") or []
        ids = [s["id"] for d in definitions for s in d["scenarios"]]
        kept = [i for i in ids if i in chosen or i.split(".")[0] in chosen]
        store.audit(actor, f"acceptance_{action}", job=job_id, kept=kept, note=note[:500])
        if action == "redefine":
            if not note.strip():
                raise Refused("say what to change: the acceptance tests are defined again from your note")
            spent = job.setdefault("revisions", {}).get("your_checks", 0)
            if spent >= 3:
                raise Refused("the acceptance tests have been defined three times; choose from these, or stop the job")
            job["revisions"]["your_checks"] = spent + 1
            heard(job, actor, "define", "sent the acceptance tests back to be defined again", note)
            job["define_feedback"] = ("The requester read these and sent them back:\n\n" + note.strip()
                                      + ("\n\nThey would keep: " + ", ".join(kept) if kept and len(kept) < len(ids) else ""))
            fixed(job, "define", job["define_feedback"], by=actor)
            return self.move(job, "define", needs=None)
        if action not in ("write", "build"):
            raise Refused("choose write or redefine")
        if not kept:
            raise Refused("keep at least one scenario to implement, or send them back with a note")
        chosen_defs = [{**d, "scenarios": [s for s in d["scenarios"] if s["id"] in kept]} for d in definitions]
        chosen_defs = [d for d in chosen_defs if d["scenarios"]]
        job["acceptance_criteria"] = [d["text"] for d in chosen_defs]
        job["proposed_tests"] = [{"criterion": f"C{n}", "scenarios": [s["text"] for s in d["scenarios"]],
                                  **({"layer": d["layer"]} if d.get("layer") else {})}
                                 for n, d in enumerate(chosen_defs, 1)]
        dropped = [i for i in ids if i not in kept]
        job["checks_choice"] = {"kept": kept, "dropped": dropped, "note": note.strip()[:4000],
                                "by": actor, "at": store.now()}
        heard(job, actor, "define", f"chose {len(kept)} of {len(ids)} scenario(s)", note)
        self.note(job, f"@{actor} chose {len(kept)} of {len(ids)} scenario(s) for {len(chosen_defs)} criteria"
                  + (f", dropped {', '.join(dropped)}" if dropped else "") + ": writing them as acceptance tests")
        return self.move(job, "specify", needs=None)

    def ask_approval(self, job: dict, text: str) -> None:
        self.move(job, "approve", "needs_you",
                  needs={"kind": "approve", "text": text,
                         "actions": ["approve", "revise", "stop"], "at": store.now()})

    # specify — the checks, before the code (docs/verification-plan.md §3)

    def do_specify(self, job: dict) -> None:
        if "property_libraries" not in job:
            # What a quantified criterion can be tested with, from the
            # repository's own manifests, before the turn is told.
            manifests = sorted({lib["manifest"] for lib in parse.PROPERTY_LIBRARIES})
            job["property_libraries"] = parse.property_libraries(sandbox.read_files(job, manifests))
        if job.get("strengthen"):
            return self.start_turn(job, "specify", briefs.strengthen(job))
        # The critical rules the plan reaches (V4): the spec turn keeps their models.
        job["critical_reached"] = [r for r in models.rules(self.repo(job))
                                   if models.touched(r, list(job.get("footprint") or []))]
        self.start_turn(job, "specify", briefs.specify(job))

    def after_specify(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        if self.interrupted(job, reply, "specify"):
            return
        found = parse.spec(parse.json_block(reply), parse.numbered_criteria(job))
        if found is None:
            job["spec_feedback"] = "The reply was not the JSON asked for, with a command and files per check."
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "specify", "the spec was not the JSON asked for", reply)
        if found["missing"]:
            job["spec_feedback"] = (f"{', '.join(found['missing'])} had no check. Every criterion "
                                    "needs at least one.")
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "specify", f"the spec left {', '.join(found['missing'])} "
                                                      "without a check", reply)
        if found["unscenarioed"]:
            job["spec_feedback"] = (f"{', '.join(found['unscenarioed'])} had no Given/When/Then scenario. "
                                    "Each criterion's checks start from at least one, in the requester's words.")
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "specify", f"the spec gave {', '.join(found['unscenarioed'])} "
                                                      "no scenario", reply)
        # The scenarios the requester chose, written as chosen.
        approved = {p["criterion"]: p["scenarios"] for p in job.get("proposed_tests") or []}
        written = {c["criterion"]: c.get("scenarios") or [] for c in found["checks"]}
        lost = [f"{cid}: {sc.splitlines()[0][:160]}" for cid, scs in approved.items() for sc in scs
                if not any(parse.same_scenario(sc, w) for w in written.get(cid, []))]
        if lost and not job.get("strengthen"):
            job["spec_feedback"] = ("The requester chose these scenarios, and they are not in your reply as "
                                    "written. Write each exactly, word for word:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"- {x}" for x in lost))
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "specify", "the spec changed the scenarios the requester chose", reply)
        layers = (self.repo(job).get("acceptance") or {}).get("layers") or {}
        if layers:
            # Each criterion runs at its layer, by that layer's command: the
            # one the plan proposed, unless the spec names one.
            planned = {p["criterion"]: p.get("layer") for p in job.get("proposed_tests") or []}
            for c in found["checks"]:
                if not c.get("layer") and planned.get(c["criterion"]):
                    c["layer"] = planned[c["criterion"]]
            unknown = [c["criterion"] for c in found["checks"] if c.get("layer") not in layers]
            if unknown:
                job["spec_feedback"] = (f"{', '.join(unknown)} had no layer, or one this repository does not have. "
                                        f"Give each check its `layer`: one of {', '.join(layers)}.")
                return self.retry_or_need(job, "specify", f"the spec gave {', '.join(unknown)} no known layer", reply)
            for c in found["checks"]:
                c["run"] = layers[c["layer"]]["run"].replace("{criterion}", c["criterion"])
        job["spec_feedback"] = ""
        if job.get("strengthen"):
            job["strengthen"]["found"] = found
            self.note(job, f"spec strengthened: {len(found['checks'])} check(s) over {len(found['files'])} file(s)")
            return self.move(job, "strengthened")
        job["spec"] = found
        self.note(job, f"spec: {len(found['checks'])} check(s) over {len(found['files'])} file(s)")
        self.move(job, "baseline")

    def do_strengthened(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """The strengthened spec, held to what a strengthening may do: every
        check passes on the change as built, passes the repository's lint, no
        scenario or file of the approved spec is gone, and no product file
        moved. Then it is the approved spec, fingerprinted again, and verify
        runs it, and the wrong implementations, once more."""
        state, repo, spec = job["strengthen"], self.repo(job), job["spec"]
        found = state["found"]
        problems = []
        before = {c["criterion"]: set(c.get("scenarios") or []) for c in spec["checks"]}
        after = {c["criterion"]: set(c.get("scenarios") or []) for c in found["checks"]}
        lost = [f"{cid}: {sc.splitlines()[0][:120]}" for cid, scs in before.items() for sc in scs - after.get(cid, set())]
        if lost:
            problems.append("- A strengthening only adds; these approved scenarios are gone: " + "; ".join(lost))
        if set(spec["files"]) - set(found["files"]):
            problems.append("- Approved test files are no longer named: "
                            + ", ".join(f"`{f}`" for f in sorted(set(spec["files"]) - set(found["files"]))))
        now = sandbox.read_files(job, sorted(state["product"]))
        moved = [f for f, h in state["product"].items() if fingerprint(now.get(f)) != h]
        stray = [f for f in sandbox.changed(job, job["base"]) if f not in state["product"] and f not in found["files"]]
        if moved or stray:
            problems.append("- Product code changed; write tests only: " + ", ".join(f"`{f}`" for f in moved + stray))
        for check in found["checks"]:
            ran = self.run_spec_check(job, repo, check)
            if not ran["ok"]:
                problems.append(f"- **{check['criterion']}**'s `{check['run']}` fails on the change as built; "
                                f"every test must pass now:\n\n```\n{ran['output'][-1500:]}\n```")
        for c in repo.get("checks") or []:
            if c.get("kind") == "lint":
                ran = self.run_lint(job, c)
                if not ran["ok"]:
                    problems.append(f"- The repository's `{c['name']}` check fails:\n\n```\n{ran['output'][-1500:]}\n```")
        if problems:
            return self.send_to_strengthen(job, state.get("survivors") or [], "\n".join(problems))
        added = sorted(f"{cid}: {sc}" for cid, scs in after.items() for sc in scs - before.get(cid, set()))
        files = sandbox.read_files(job, found["files"])
        for c in found["checks"]:
            c["base"] = next((o.get("base") for o in spec["checks"] if o["criterion"] == c["criterion"]), {})
        job["spec"] = {**spec, "checks": found["checks"], "files": found["files"],
                       "hashes": {**{f: fingerprint(files[f]) for f in found["files"] if f in files},
                                  **{f: h for f, h in spec.get("hashes", {}).items() if f in (spec.get("model_files") or [])}},
                       "rounds": list(spec.get("rounds") or []) + [{"at": store.now(), "added": added,
                                                                    "survivors": state.get("survivors") or []}]}
        job["strengthen"] = None
        job["spec_feedback"] = ""
        self.note(job, f"the approved checks were strengthened: {len(added)} scenario(s) added")
        self.move(job, "verify")

    def send_to_strengthen(self, job: dict, survivors: list, feedback: str = "") -> None:
        """Back to the spec turn with the wrong implementations the approved
        checks let through, bounded; past the budget, a person decides."""
        spent = job.setdefault("revisions", {}).get("strengthen", 0)
        budget = int((job.get("settings") or {}).get("revisions", config.REVISIONS).get(
            "strengthen", config.REVISIONS["strengthen"]))
        if spent >= budget:
            listed = "\n".join(f"- `{s['file']}:{s['line']}`: `{s['was']}` → `{s['now']}`" for s in survivors)
            return self.need(job, "stuck", f"After {spent} round(s) of strengthening, the approved checks still "
                                           f"pass these wrong implementations:\n\n{listed}\n\n{feedback}".strip(),
                             ["ship_anyway", "stop"])
        job["revisions"]["strengthen"] = spent + 1
        changed = sandbox.changed(job, job["base"])
        product = [f for f in changed if f not in approved_files(job["spec"])]
        files = sandbox.read_files(job, product)
        job["strengthen"] = {"survivors": survivors, "product": {f: fingerprint(files.get(f)) for f in product}}
        job["spec_feedback"] = feedback
        if feedback:
            fixed(job, "strengthen", feedback)
        self.note(job, f"{len(survivors)} wrong implementation(s) passed the approved checks; "
                       f"strengthening them, round {spent + 1} of {budget}")
        self.move(job, "specify")

        passes on the base does not check this change; a file it names that is
        not there, or anything it changed beyond its checks, is not a spec.

        spec files are fingerprinted here; from now on they are the approved
        ones."""

        spec = job["spec"]

        blocked = self.hold_to_models(job, repo, spec)

        # What the turn changed, read before its tests run: a test that writes

        if spec.get("runner_files"):

        layer = repo.get("acceptance") or {}

                                                     *(lay.get("steps") for lay in (layer.get("layers") or {}).values()))
                 if d]
        spec["outside_layer"] = [f for f in spec["files"] if homes and not any(f.startswith(h) for h in homes)
                                 and "fixture" not in f.lower()]
        # Gherkin unless the repository says otherwise (`acceptance.gherkin: false`).
        spec["no_gherkin"] = (spec.get("ungherkined") or []) if layer.get("gherkin", True) is not False else []
        features = str(layer.get("features") or "").rstrip("/")
        spec["feature_elsewhere"] = [f for f in spec["files"] if features and f.endswith(".feature")

        # when the sprite restarts, and the tests with it.

        self.note(job, f"baseline: {len(spec['checks']) - len(green)} of {len(spec['checks'])} "

        budget = int((job.get("settings") or {}).get("revisions", config.REVISIONS).get(
            "specify", config.REVISIONS["specify"]))

    def run_lint(self, job: dict, check: dict) -> dict:
        ran = sandbox.run_check(job, check["run"], minutes=check.get("timeout_minutes"))
        return {"ok": ran.ok, "output": sandbox.output(ran, 3000)}

    def run_spec_check(self, job: dict, repo: dict, check: dict, written_by_turn: bool = True) -> dict:
        """A check's command, run where its author ran it: a turn's in the
        repository's container, the repository's own (a critical rule's
        `test`) on the sprite."""
        started = time.time()
        runner = sandbox.run_in_workspace if written_by_turn else sandbox.run_check
        result = runner(job, check["run"], minutes=repo.get("timeout_minutes"))
        return {"ok": result.ok, "code": result.code, "seconds": round(time.time() - started, 1),
                "output": sandbox.output(result, 3000)}

    # implement

    def capture_surface(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """The repository's surface before anything is built (its route list),
        once, for the gates that compare it with the finished change. Taken
        before the first turn that may write product code; a failure is kept
        on the job, and the gate reports a measurement it could not make."""
        if not surfaces(self.repo(job)) or "surface_base" in job:
            return
        key = f"{job['id']}:surface"
        if self.alive(key):
            self.note(job, "waiting for the surface before the change, measured since setup")
            self.threads[key].join(1800)
        early = store.prepare(key)
        job["surface_base"] = early["base"] if early.get("state") == "ok" else self.measure_surface(job)

    def measure_surface(self, job: dict) -> dict:
        """Each surface, read from the sprite as the base leaves it. Writes no
        job record: run on a thread, the record is the caller's."""
        wanted, found = surfaces(self.repo(job)), {}
        if any(s["stack"] for s in wanted.values()):
            # A surface read from the running app (a page's accessibility) needs
            # the stack as a commit leaves it: seeded, signed-in users there.
            problem = sandbox.ready(job, self.repo(job))
            if problem:
                self.note(job, f"the stack could not be readied to read the surface: {problem[:300]}")
        for name, entry in wanted.items():
            ran = sandbox.capture_surface(job, name, entry["run"])
            found[name] = {"ok": ran.ok, "at": store.now(), **({} if ran.ok else {"error": sandbox.output(ran, 1000)})}
            self.note(job, f"surface {name} before the change: {'captured' if ran.ok else 'NOT captured'}")
        return found

    def do_implement(self, job: dict) -> None:
        self.capture_surface(job)
        revision = job.get("revise")
        if revision:
            return self.start_turn(job, "implement",
                                   briefs.revise(job, revision["from"], revision["feedback"]))
        task = self.next_task(job)
        if task is None:
            return self.move(job, "checks")
        self.start_turn(job, "implement", briefs.implement(job, task), task=task["id"])

    def next_task(self, job: dict) -> dict | None:
        done = set(job.get("done_tasks") or [])
        return next((t for t in (job.get("discovery") or {}).get("tasks") or []
                     if t["id"] not in done), None)

    def after_implement(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        if self.interrupted(job, reply, "implement"):
            return
        job.setdefault("summaries", []).append({"task": turn.get("task") or "revision",
                                                "text": reply.strip()[:6000]})
        revision = job.pop("revise", None)
        if revision:
            return self.move(job, revision["back_to"])
        if turn.get("task"):
            job.setdefault("done_tasks", []).append(turn["task"])
        self.move(job, "implement" if self.next_task(job) else "checks")

    # checks — tier 1, no model

    def do_checks(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """Tests pass: the whole test suite (the repository's test checks, or
        `tests.run`), then the ATDD tests (`verify`). Lint, static analysis and
        the commit hook are Quality's."""
        repo = self.repo(job)
        results = self.autofix(job, "checks", self.run_checks(job, repo, "tests"), checks_for(repo, "tests"))
        job["checks"] = results
        job["stat"] = sandbox.stat(job, job["base"])
        failed = [r for r in results if r["required"] and not r["ok"]]
        # Only the factory's own gate tools mean "could not measure" by exit 2.
        # A repository's check is its own command, and `make` exits 2 when a
        # recipe fails (j862122f69c8b's lint): that is a finding, for the fix turn.
        broken = [r for r in failed if r.get("broken")]
        if broken:
            return self.need(job, "stuck", "A gate's own tool failed, so it measured nothing:\n\n" + "\n\n".join(
                f"`{r['name']}` (`{r['run']}`): {r['output'][-1500:]}" for r in broken), ["retry", "stop"])

            job["snapshot"] = sandbox.snapshot(job, repo, job["title"])
            job["tests_written"] = tests_written(job, repo)
            # Green is the ATDD checks too: they run next ("Checks pass" on
            # the rail), before quality and review.
            return self.move(job, "verify" if job.get("spec") else after_green(job))
        feedback = "\n\n".join(f"### `{r['name']}` failed: `{r['run']}` (exit {r['code']})\n\n"

    def run_checks(self, job: dict, repo: dict, part: str = "all") -> list[dict]:
        """The repository's checks, then the delivery constraints over what changed.
        `part`: "tests" (Tests pass: the test suites) or "quality" (the rest:
        lint, static analysis, the commit hook last, and the delivery
        constraints), or "all"."""
        sandbox.tidy(job, repo)
        results = []
        failing = False
        for check in checks_for(repo, "all" if part == "ci" else part):
            if check.get("hook"):
                # Last, and only on a change the other checks passed: the hook
                # repeats them, and its pass is kept for the tree it ran on.
                if failing:
                    continue
                tree = sandbox.tree_hash(job, repo)
            started = time.time()
            # The hook may run the stack (the portal's e2e smoke), so the stack
            # is readied for a commit first, as sandbox.commit did before it.
            problem = sandbox.ready(job, repo) if check.get("hook") else None
            if problem:
                failing = True
                results.append({"name": check["name"], "kind": check["kind"], "run": check["run"], "required": True,
                                "ok": False, "code": 1, "seconds": round(time.time() - started, 1), "hook": True,

    def revise(self, job: dict, stage: str, feedback: str, back_to: str) -> None:
        """Hand a refusal back as the next turn's brief, bounded.

        A refusal repeated word for word stops early: a check that says the same
        thing twice has proved its complaint is not about the diff, and the
        third turn would learn nothing the second did not.
        """
        spent = job.setdefault("revisions", {}).get(stage, 0)
        budget = int((job.get("settings") or {}).get("revisions", config.REVISIONS).get(
            stage, config.REVISIONS.get(stage, 1)))
        repeated = feedback.strip() == (job.get("last_refusal") or {}).get(stage)
        if spent >= budget or repeated:
            why = "said the same thing twice" if repeated else f"still refused after {spent} revision(s)"
            return self.need(job, "stuck", f"The {stage} stage {why}.\n\n{feedback}",
                             ["retry", "revise", "ship_anyway", "stop"] if stage not in ("checks", "ci")
                             else ["retry", "revise", "stop"])
        job["revisions"][stage] = spent + 1
        job.setdefault("last_refusal", {})[stage] = feedback.strip()
        fixed(job, stage, feedback)
        job["revise"] = {"from": stage, "feedback": feedback[:12000], "back_to": back_to}
        self.note(job, f"{stage} refused; revision {spent + 1} of {budget}")
        self.move(job, "implement")

    # quality — tier 2: is it implemented well?

    # after Refactor: the acceptance tests pass, and nothing else here. The
    # repository's checks and CI run on the pull request (watch_ci, ci_fix).

    def do_acceptance(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """Acceptance tests pass: the acceptance tests, after Refactor."""
        if not job.get("spec"):
            self.move(job, after_green(job))
            return
        self.do_verify(job)

    def gates_before_push(self, job: dict) -> list[dict]:
        """The constraints that refuse and are carried at delivery, run before a
        push: a secret is public once pushed, before CI can say anything, and a
        weakened test is what a fix aimed at CI would reach for."""
        snap = job.get("constraints") or []
        refusing = [c for c in snap if c.get("policy", constraints.REFUSE) == constraints.REFUSE]
        saved = job.get("constraints")
        job["constraints"] = refusing
        try:
            rows = self.delivery_constraints(job)
        finally:
            job["constraints"] = saved
        names = {r["name"] for r in rows}
        job["checks"] = [r for r in job.get("checks") or [] if r["name"] not in names] + rows
        return [r for r in rows if r.get("required", True) and not r["ok"]]


    def do_prove(self, job: dict) -> None:
        problem = sandbox.serve(job, self.repo(job))
        if problem:
            self.note(job, problem)
        job["prototype_url"] = sandbox.url(job)
        self.start_turn(job, "prove", briefs.prove(job))

    def after_prove(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        verdict = parse.proof(reply)
        covered, asked = parse.coverage(parse.proof_criteria(job), reply)
        evidence = sandbox.pull_evidence(job, store.evidence_dir(job["id"]))
        text, steps = parse.uat(reply)
        job["proof"] = {"verdict": verdict, "text": text.strip()[:30000],
                        "coverage": [covered, asked], "evidence": evidence}
        job["uat_steps"] = steps
        self.note(job, f"PROVEN: {verdict} ({covered}/{asked} criteria), {len(evidence)} file(s)")
        if verdict == "yes" and covered < asked:
            # Every acceptance criterion is proven, or the proof is not a pass.
            verdict = "partial"
            job["proof"]["verdict"] = verdict
            self.note(job, f"downgraded to partial: {asked - covered} acceptance criteria not checked off")
        require = (self.repo(job).get("proof") or {}).get("require") or []
        missing = config.missing_evidence(require, evidence)
        if missing and verdict in ("yes", "partial"):
            verdict = "unproven"
            job["proof"]["verdict"] = verdict
            job["proof"]["missing"] = missing
            self.note(job, f"downgraded to unproven: no {', '.join(missing)} in the evidence")
            # The change did what was asked; the proof lacks what this
            # repository requires of it (a screenshot with no browser in the
            # sprite, ja0b1eab3f00a). Nothing the build changes makes a
            # browser appear: a person decides, never a rebuild.
            self.need(job, "proof", f"The proof showed the criteria it checked, and carried no "
                             f"{', '.join(missing)}, which this repository requires. That is the proof's "
                             "environment, not the change: retry once it can take one, or accept it.\n\n"
                             + reply.strip()[:8000], ["retry", "ship_anyway", "stop"])
            return
        if verdict == "yes":
            return self.move(job, "comprehend")
        if verdict == "partial":
            # Some criteria could not be run, or the feature works and misses the
            # goal. Either way it is a person's call whether that ships to UAT.
            return self.need(job, "proof", reply.strip()[:8000], ["retry", "ship_anyway", "revise", "stop"])
        why = (f"PROVEN: {verdict}" + (f" — the proof carried no {', '.join(missing)}; "
                                       f"this repository requires one" if missing else ""))
        self.revise(job, "prove", f"{why}\n\n{reply.strip()[:8000]}", back_to="checks")

    def keep_read_only(self, job: dict, turn: dict) -> bool:
        """A turn with a shell and no editor leaves the tree as it found it,
        however it ended: replied, failed or stopped.

        Withholding the editor alone did not hold this. The shell can write
        (`sed -i`, a redirect, `git commit`), so the tree is read before the
        turn (`harness.start`'s `before`) and put back after, and what changed
        goes on the record. Only the tree: what a command does outside it (a
        database, the stack's own files) is not undone."""
        was = turn.get("tree")
        if not was:
            return True
        try:
            now = sandbox.tree(job, self.repo(job))
            if now == was:
                return True
            committed = now["head"] != was["head"] or now["branch"] != was["branch"]
            files = sorted(set(now["files"]) ^ set(was["files"]))
            sandbox.put_back(job, was)
        except sandbox.Failed as exc:
            # Carrying on would hand the next stage a tree a read-only turn may
            # have changed; a person decides.
            job["turn"] = None
            harness.record_session(self.trigger, job, turn, f"failed: {exc}")
            self.need(job, "stuck", f"The {turn['stage']} turn may have changed the repository, and it could "
                                    f"not be checked or put back: {exc}", ["stop"])
            return False
        what = (f"{len(files)} file(s)" + (f" and moved {was['branch'] or 'HEAD'} to {now['branch'] or 'HEAD'}"
                                            f" at {now['head'][:12]}" if committed else ""))
        self.note(job, f"{turn['stage']} changed {what}; put back: {files[:10]}")
        job.setdefault("touched", {})[turn["stage"]] = files[:50]
        store.trace("trace.tree.put_back", job["id"], session=turn["session_id"], stage=turn["stage"],
                    requester=job.get("requester"), files=files[:200], committed=committed,
                    was=was, found={**now, "files": now["files"][:200]})
        return True

    def guard_tree(self, job: dict, stage: str) -> None:
        """The factory's own quality tools have a shell. What they changed is
        reverted and recorded, never kept."""
        changed = sandbox.touched(job, self.repo(job))
        if changed:
            self.note(job, f"{stage} changed {len(changed)} file(s); reverted: {changed[:10]}")
            job.setdefault("touched", {})[stage] = changed[:50]
            sandbox.revert(job)

    # review

    def do_review(self, job: dict) -> None:
        if job.get("reviewed"):
            # Reviewed once, and what the person chose was built and green
            # again: on to the pull request.
            self.move(job, "ship")
            return
        self.do_review_turn(job)

    def do_refactor(self, job: dict) -> None:
        diff, omitted = sandbox.diff(job, job["base"])
        self.start_turn(job, "refactor", briefs.refactor(job, diff, omitted))

    def after_refactor(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        """The proposals, put to the person (or, with none, straight on)."""
        found = parse.refactors(parse.json_block(reply))
        job["refactor"] = {"options": found, "at": store.now()}
        self.note(job, f"refactor: {len(found)} proposal(s)")
        if not found and not job.get("tests_written"):
            job["refactored"] = True
            # After Refactor, whatever was applied: acceptance tests, then the checks.
            self.move(job, "acceptance")
            return
        self.move(job, "refactor", "needs_you", needs={"kind": "refactor", "at": store.now(),
                  "actions": ["apply_refactor", "continue_refactor", "stop"],
                  "text": f"The change is green. {len(found)} refactoring(s) proposed, and the tests the build "
                          "wrote to choose from: choose what to apply. It goes back to the build, and every check "
                          "must pass again."})

    def choose_refactor(self, actor: str, job_id: str, chosen: list[str], note: str = "",
                        tests: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
        """The person's refactorings: applied by the build, behaviour unchanged,
        and green again before review. None chosen carries on to review."""
        job = self.load(job_id)
        if job.get("state") != "needs_you" or (job.get("needs") or {}).get("kind") != "refactor":
            raise Refused("this job is not waiting on its refactoring")
        options = {o["id"]: o for o in (job.get("refactor") or {}).get("options") or []}
        picked = [options[c] for c in chosen if c in options]
        written = {t["id"]: t for t in job.get("tests_written") or []}
        reworked = [written[t] for t in tests or [] if t in written]
        job["refactor"]["chosen"] = [o["id"] for o in picked]
        job["refactor"]["declined"] = [o for o in options if o not in job["refactor"]["chosen"]]
        job["refactored"] = True
        store.audit(actor, "refactor_chosen", job=job_id, chosen=job["refactor"]["chosen"], note=note[:500])
        job["refactor"]["tests"] = [t["id"] for t in reworked]
        if not picked and not reworked and not note.strip():
            heard(job, actor, "refactor", "carried on without refactoring", note)
            # After Refactor, whatever was applied: acceptance tests, then the checks.
            return self.move(job, "acceptance", needs=None)
        heard(job, actor, "refactor", f"chose {len(picked)} refactoring(s)", note)
        feedback = ("The change is green. The requester chose these refactorings. The behaviour must not "
                    "change: every check passes now and must still pass after.\n\n" + "\n".join(
                        f"- **{o['title']}** — {o['why']}" + (f" ({', '.join(o['where'])})" if o["where"] else "")
                        for o in picked)
                    + ("\n\nAnd these tests you wrote, to rework as they say (rewrite, strengthen or drop):\n\n"
                       + "\n".join(f"- `{t['file']}` ({t['layer']}): " + ", ".join(t["names"][:8]) for t in reworked)
                       if reworked else "")
                    + (f"\n\nThey add: {note.strip()}" if note.strip() else ""))
        fixed(job, "refactor", feedback, by=actor)
        job["revise"] = {"from": "refactor", "feedback": feedback[:12000], "back_to": "acceptance"}
        return self.move(job, "implement", needs=None)

    def do_falsify(self, job: dict) -> None:
        spec = job["spec"]
        green = [c for c in spec["checks"] if c["base"]["ok"] and not (c.get("falsified") or {}).get("ok")]
        job["falsify_backup"] = sandbox.read_files(job, approved_files(spec))
        job["falsify_before"] = sorted(sandbox.changed(job, job["base"]))
        self.start_turn(job, "falsify", briefs.falsify(job, green))

    def after_falsify(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        """Each green test against the product code broken on purpose: it must
        go red. Then every product change is undone, and it must be green again.
        A test proven able to fail stands; one that stayed green is no test."""
        spec, repo = job["spec"], self.repo(job)
        said = {str(i.get("criterion", "")).upper(): str(i.get("what") or "")[:600]
                for i in ((parse.json_block(reply) or {}).get("falsified") or []) if isinstance(i, dict)}
        approved = set(approved_files(spec))
        before = set(job.pop("falsify_before", None) or [])
        sabotage = [f for f in sandbox.changed(job, job["base"]) if f not in approved and f not in before]
        backup = job.pop("falsify_backup", None) or {}
        touched = {f: t for f, t in backup.items()
                   if fingerprint((sandbox.read_files(job, [f]) or {}).get(f)) != fingerprint(t)}
        if touched:
            # The tests are the contract: put back as they were, whatever the turn did.
            sandbox.put_files(job, touched)
        green = [c for c in spec["checks"] if c["base"]["ok"] and not (c.get("falsified") or {}).get("ok")]
        red = {c["criterion"]: not self.run_spec_check(job, repo, c)["ok"] for c in green}
        tracked = sandbox.tracked(job, sabotage)
        sandbox.restore(job, tracked)
        sandbox.remove_files(job, [f for f in sabotage if f not in tracked])
        for check in green:
            again = self.run_spec_check(job, repo, check)
            check["falsified"] = {"ok": red[check["criterion"]] and again["ok"] and not touched,
                                  "went_red": red[check["criterion"]], "green_again": again["ok"],
                                  "what": said.get(check["criterion"], ""), "files": sabotage[:20]}
        proven = [c["criterion"] for c in green if c["falsified"]["ok"]]
        self.note(job, f"falsified: {len(proven)} of {len(green)} green test(s) went red when the code was broken "
                       f"on purpose, and green again when it was put back"
                       + (f"; {', '.join(c['criterion'] for c in green if not c['falsified']['ok'])} did not" if
                          len(proven) < len(green) else ""))
        self.move(job, "baseline")

    def do_review_turn(self, job: dict) -> None:
        diff, omitted = sandbox.diff(job, job["base"])
        self.start_turn(job, "review", briefs.review(job, diff, omitted))

    def after_review(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        verdict = parse.verdict(reply)
        policy = (self.repo(job).get("review") or {}).get("policy", "ask")
        blocking = policy == "blocking"
        found = escapes.classify(job, parse.findings(reply))
        job["review"] = {"verdict": verdict, "text": reply.strip()[:20000], "advisory": not blocking,
                         "findings": found, "policy": policy}
        self.note(job, f"VERDICT: {verdict}, {len(found)} finding(s)"
                  + {"blocking": "", "advisory": " (advisory: recorded, holds nothing back)",
                     "ask": " (put to the requester)" if found else ""}[policy])
        if policy == "ask" and found:
            return self.need(job, "review", f"The review found {len(found)} thing(s). Choose which to "
                                            "address: those go back to the build, every check must pass "
                                            "again, and the rest are recorded as declined.",
                             ["apply_review", "continue_review", "stop"])
        if verdict == "blocker" and blocking:
            # Fixed automatically once, with the findings as the brief; a
            # blocker that survives a fix is a person's call.
            return self.revise(job, "review", "The review found a blocker:\n\n" + reply.strip()[:8000],
                               back_to="checks")

        # change against every acceptance criterion.

    # verify — is it what was asked? No model: the approved checks, at the head

    def do_verify(self, job: dict) -> None:
        spec, repo = job["spec"], self.repo(job)
        files = sandbox.read_files(job, approved_files(spec))
        changed = [f for f, h in spec.get("hashes", {}).items() if fingerprint(files.get(f)) != h]
        rows = [{"criterion": c["criterion"], "text": c["text"], "run": c["run"],
                 "base_ok": c.get("base", {}).get("ok"), **self.run_spec_check(job, repo, c)}
                for c in spec["checks"]]
        # A critical rule's code against its proved model (V4): held like a criterion.
        critical = [{"criterion": c["name"], "text": "the code agrees with its proved model on every vector",
                     "run": c["test"], "base_ok": c.get("base_ok"),
                     **self.run_spec_check(job, repo, {"run": c["test"]}, written_by_turn=False)}
                    for c in spec.get("critical") or []]
        failing = [r for r in rows + critical if not r["ok"]]
        policy = (repo.get("verify") or {}).get("policy", "observe")
        job["conformance"] = {"rows": rows, "critical": critical, "changed": changed, "policy": policy,
                              "ok": not failing and not changed, "at": store.now()}
        self.note(job, f"verify: {len(rows) - len([r for r in rows if not r['ok']])} of {len(rows)} criteria met"
                       + (f"; {sum(r['ok'] for r in critical)} of {len(critical)} critical rule(s) agree with "
                          "their proved models" if critical else "")
                       + (f"; approved checks changed: {', '.join(changed)}" if changed else "")
                       )
        strength = (repo.get("verify") or {}).get("strength", "observe")
        # Measured once, at the first green (and again after a strengthening):
        # the run after Refactor checks the tests still pass, nothing more.
        if job["conformance"]["ok"] and strength != "off" and not job.get("refactored"):
            self.spec_strength(job)
            survivors = (job.get("spec_strength") or {}).get("survivors") or []
            if strength == "refuse" and survivors:
                return self.send_to_strengthen(job, survivors)
        if job["conformance"]["ok"]:
            return self.move(job, after_green(job))
        if changed:
            store.record_constraint(job["id"], {
                "kind": "refused", "id": secrets.token_hex(6), "stage": "verify", "requester": job.get("requester", ""),
                "constraint": "the-spec-is-not-the-implementers", "carrier": constraints.PROCESS,
                "why": "an approved check was changed after approval", "tool": "the finished change",
                "args": {"files": ", ".join(changed)[:2000]}, "reason": "changed: " + ", ".join(changed),
                "at": store.now()})

            # what changed, and putting them back would be a check repairing.
            return self.need(job, "stuck", "The approved checks were changed after the plan was "
                                           "approved:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"- `{f}`" for f in changed)
                             + "\n\nA passing run of a changed check says nothing about the request.",
                             ["ship_anyway", "stop"])

        if cannot_run:

            # /tmp with the sprite, ja0b1eab3f00a): a rebuild changes nothing.
            self.need(job, "stuck", "The acceptance tests could not run, so they said nothing about the "
                             "change:\n\n" + "\n\n".join(f"- **{r['criterion']}** `{r['run']}` (exit {r['code']}): "
                                                          f"{(r['output'] or '').strip()[-400:]}" for r in cannot_run)

                                f"(exit {r['code']})\n\n```\n{r['output']}\n```" for r in failing)

    # comprehend — the change, for a person

    def do_comprehend(self, job: dict) -> None:
        diff, omitted = sandbox.diff(job, job["base"])
        self.start_turn(job, "comprehend", briefs.comprehend(job, diff, omitted))

    def after_comprehend(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        """Kept if it has the sections a reviewer navigates by; never a gate."""
        text = reply.strip()
        present = [name for name in briefs.COMPREHENSION_SECTIONS if f"## {name}" in text]
        if len(present) < 4:
            self.note(job, f"the briefing had {len(present)} of its sections; shipping without it")
            job["comprehension"] = None
        else:
            text, drawn = parse.diagrams(text, briefs.DIAGRAM_KINDS)
            job["comprehension"] = {"text": text[:20000], "sections": present, "diagrams": drawn}
            self.note(job, "briefing written for the reviewer"
                      + (f", with {drawn} diagram{'s' if drawn != 1 else ''}" if drawn else ""))
        if job.get("pr_url"):
            # The proof and the briefing were made after the pull request was
            # opened: its description is written again with them.
            try:
                forge.edit_pr(job, pr_body(job))
                self.note(job, "the pull request's description now carries the proof and the briefing")

except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — the job carries them either way
                self.note(job, f"could not update the pull request's description: {exc}")
        # A job from before the proof followed the pull request has none yet.
        self.move(job, "uat" if job.get("pr_url") else "ship")

    def do_ship(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """Commit in the sprite (the repository's hook runs there); push and open
        the pull request from here, as the requester."""
        repo = self.repo(job)
        title = job["title"] if not job.get("source", {}).get("key") else \
            f"{job['source']['key']}: {job['title']}"
        refused = self.gates_before_push(job)
        broken = [r for r in refused if r.get("broken")]
        if broken:
            # The measurement failed, not the code: a person, not the fixer.
            self.need(job, "stuck", "A gate's own tool failed, so it measured nothing:\n\n" + "\n\n".join(
                f"`{r['name']}` (`{r['run']}`): {r['output'][-1500:]}" for r in broken), ["retry", "stop"])
            return
        if refused:
            # Back to the build with what was found; the acceptance tests run
            # again, then the push is tried again (bounded).
            self.revise(job, "ship", "Before this could be pushed:\n\n" + "\n\n".join(
                f"### `{r['name']}` refused it\n\n```\n{r['output']}\n```" for r in refused), back_to="acceptance")
            return
        committed, reused = sandbox.commit(job, repo, title, (job.get("hook_passed") or {}).get("tree", ""))
        if reused:
            self.note(job, f"the commit hook passed in the checks on this exact tree "
                           f"({job['hook_passed']['tree'][:12]}); not run again")
            store.audit("wipp-factory", "hook_reused", job=job["id"], on_behalf_of=job["requester"],
                        tree=job["hook_passed"]["tree"])
        if not committed.ok:
            # The hook is CI run early: fixed where it failed, at the pull
            # request, by the same loop as CI, never back through the build.
            self.fix_at_pull_request(job, "The repository's own pre-commit hook refused the commit:\n\n"
                                          f"```\n{sandbox.output(committed, 8000)}\n```", what="the commit hook")
            return
        sha = forge.push_bundle(job, repo, sandbox.bundle(job, repo))
        store.audit("wipp-factory", "pushed", job=job["id"], on_behalf_of=job["requester"], branch=job["branch"],
                    sha=sha, repo=job["repo"])
        job["pushed_sha"] = sha
        # A sign-off belongs to the change that was looked at: a new push clears it.
        if job.pop("signoff", None):
            self.note(job, "a new commit was pushed; UAT is signed off again before a merge")
        job["ci"] = {"state": "pending", "head": sha}
        self.note(job, f"pushed {job['branch']} at {sha[:10]} as {job['requester']}")
        job["prototype_url"] = job.get("prototype_url") or sandbox.url(job)
        if not job.get("pr_url"):
            job["pr_url"] = forge.open_pr(job, repo, title, pr_body(job))
            store.audit("wipp-factory", "pr_opened", job=job["id"], on_behalf_of=job["requester"],
                        pr=job["pr_url"], title=title)
            # The commit readied the stack for its hook, not for reviewers; serve
        # the preview again so it answers at its own address.
        problem = sandbox.serve(job, repo)
        if problem:
            self.note(job, f"the preview may not answer: {problem}")
        # CI runs on the push; when it passes on this commit, the proof and the
        # briefing follow (reconcile_pr), on the change as it will be merged.
        self.move(job, "ci", "waiting", shipped=store.now())

    # uat — before the merge, by a person: the requester tries the change in its
    # preview and signs it off, or sends it back. The proof before it already
    # walked every criterion in a browser; acceptance is a person's to give,
    # and an automated pass here only repeated the proof (and once replied to
    # the proof's file, stopping the first real job).

    def do_uat(self, job: dict) -> None:
        self.move(job, "uat", "needs_you",
                  needs={"kind": "uat", "text": "Try it in the preview, then sign UAT off or send it back.",
                         "actions": ["uat_pass", "uat_fail", "stop"], "at": store.now()})

    def sign_off(self, actor: str, job_id: str, passed: bool, note: str = "") -> dict:
        """The requester's UAT verdict on the commit in the preview. Passed:
        the merge is allowed, for this commit only. Failed: the note is the next
        build's brief, and the change comes back through every guardrail to
        UAT. Nothing was merged, so nothing needs undoing."""
        job = self.load(job_id)
        if (job.get("needs") or {}).get("kind") != "uat":
            raise Refused("this job is not waiting for a UAT sign-off")
        note = note.strip()
        sha = job.get("pushed_sha", "")
        if passed:
            job["signoff"] = {"by": actor, "at": store.now(), "sha": sha, "note": note[:2000]}
            store.audit(actor, "uat_passed", job=job_id, sha=sha, note=note[:500])
            found = oversight.policy(job.get("repo", ""), "merge")
            job["merge_oversight"] = {**found, "until": oversight.due(found, store.now())}
            return self.move(job, "preview", "waiting", needs=None)
        if not note:
            raise Refused("say what failed: your note is what the next build works from")
        store.audit(actor, "uat_failed", job=job_id, sha=sha, note=note[:500])
        escapes.record(job, "uat_failed", note, by=actor, sha=sha)
        fixed(job, "uat", note, by=actor)
        job["revise"] = {"from": "uat", "feedback": note[:12000], "back_to": "checks"}
        job["revisions"] = {}
        return self.move(job, "implement", needs=None)

    def do_revive(self, job: dict) -> None:
        """Rebuild a torn-down preview from the branch that was pushed."""
        repo = self.repo(job)
        sandbox.create(job)
        # A new sprite: nothing has run in it, so it may be given the clone token.
        job["sprite_tainted"] = False
        sandbox.clone(job, repo, forge.token(job["requester"]))
        sandbox.install_tools(job)
        problem = sandbox.prepare(job, repo, lambda line: self.note(job, line))
        if problem:
            return self.need(job, "stuck", f"Reviving the preview failed.\n\n{problem}",
                             ["revive", "stop"])
        store.prepare(job["id"], {"state": "ok", "finished": store.now()})
        problem = sandbox.serve(job, repo)
        if problem:
            self.note(job, problem)
        job["prototype_url"] = sandbox.url(job)
        self.note(job, f"preview revived at {job['prototype_url']}")
        if job.pop("ci_fix_pending", None):
            # Revived to fix CI, not just to be looked at.
            self.move(job, "ci_fix", needs=None)
        elif job.get("revise"):
            self.move(job, "implement", needs=None)
        else:
            self.move(job, "preview", "waiting", needs=None)

    # onboarding a repository

    def onboard(self, actor: str, name: str, remote: str) -> dict:
        job_id = store.new_id()
        job = {"id": job_id, "kind": "onboard", "repo": name, "requester": actor,
               "title": f"onboard {name}", "request": f"Onboard {remote}",
               "settings": {"remote": remote, "base": "main", "branch_prefix": "wipp/",
                            "workdir": f"/home/sprite/work/{name}", "prepare": []},
               "sprite": sandbox.name_for(job_id), "workdir": f"/home/sprite/work/{name}",
               "branch": f"wipp/onboard-{job_id}", "base": "main", "stage": "provision",
               "state": "ready", "created": store.now(), "attempt": {}, "overrides": {},
               "history": [], "cost_usd": 0.0, "turns": 0, "constraints": constraints.snapshot()}
        store.save(job)
        store.audit(actor, "onboard", job=job_id, repo=name, remote=remote)
        return job

    def do_onboard(self, job: dict) -> None:
        self.start_turn(job, "onboard", briefs.onboard(job))

    def after_onboard(self, job: dict, reply: str, turn: dict) -> None:
        found = re.search(r"```ya?ml\s*(.*?)```", reply, re.DOTALL)
        job["draft"] = (found.group(1) if found else reply).strip()[:20000]
        if job.get("kind") == "onboard":
            return self.need(job, "onboard", "A settings block was drafted for this repository. "
                                             "Edit it if needed, then accept it.", ["accept_repo", "stop"])
        # A request against a repository nobody had set up: use the draft for
        # this job, keep it as a proposal an admin can make permanent, carry on.
        drafted = read_draft(job["draft"])
        if drafted is None:
            return self.retry_or_need(job, "onboard", "the repository's settings were not readable YAML",
                                      reply)
        merged = settings_from_draft(job["settings"], drafted)
        job["settings"] = merged
        job["needs_onboarding"] = False
        save_proposal(job["repo"], job["draft"], job["id"], job["requester"])
        self.note(job, f"settings drafted for {job['repo']}: {len(merged.get('prepare') or [])} prepare "
                       f"step(s), {len(merged['checks'])} check(s); kept as a proposal for an admin")
        if drafted.get("notes"):
            self.note(job, f"onboarding notes: {str(drafted['notes'])[:500]}")
        self.start_prepare(job)
        # Setup is a step of its own, with its progress on the job's page: the
        # first turn waits for it, and "Size it up" spinning through minutes of
        # `docker compose up` looked like a stall.
        self.move(job, "prepare")

    # --- what a human does ---

    def answer_questions(self, actor: str, job_id: str, answers: dict) -> dict:
        job = self.expect(job_id, "questions")
        asked = {q["id"] for q in job["discovery"]["questions"]}
        job["answers"] = {k: str(v).strip()[:2000] for k, v in answers.items() if k in asked and str(v).strip()}
        for q in job["discovery"]["questions"]:
            job["answers"].setdefault(q["id"], f"(no answer — use the default: {q['default']})"
                                      if q.get("default") else "(no answer — use your judgement)")
        store.audit(actor, "answer", job=job_id, count=len(answers))
        return self.move(job, "plan", needs=None)

    def answer_interrupt(self, actor: str, job_id: str, answer: str) -> dict:
        job = self.expect(job_id, "interrupt")
        pending = [i for i in job["interrupts"] if not i.get("answer")]
        pending[-1].update({"answer": answer.strip()[:4000], "answered_by": actor,
                            "answered_at": store.now()})
        store.audit(actor, "answer_interrupt", job=job_id)
        heard(job, actor, pending[-1]["stage"], f"asked \"{pending[-1]['question'][:300]}\"", answer)
        return self.move(job, pending[-1]["stage"], needs=None)

    def approve(self, actor: str, job_id: str, decision: str, note: str = "") -> dict:
        job = self.expect(job_id, "approve")
        store.audit(actor, f"plan_{decision}", job=job_id, note=note[:500])
        job["approval"] = {"by": actor, "at": store.now(), "decision": decision, "note": note}
        if note.strip():
            heard(job, actor, "plan", f"plan {'approved' if decision == 'approve' else 'sent back'}", note)
        if decision == "approve":
            # A repository that verifies writes its checks first, as the build's
            # opening steps; they must fail before anything is built.
            return self.move(job, "define" if self.repo(job).get("verify") else "implement", needs=None)
        if decision == "revise":
            job["plan_feedback"] = note.strip() or "Revise the plan."
            return self.move(job, "plan", needs=None)
        raise Refused("decision must be approve or revise")

    def address_review(self, actor: str, job_id: str, chosen: list[str], note: str = "") -> dict:
        """The requester's answer to the review: the findings they chose, and
        anything they add, go back to the build as a fix brief, the way a check's
        refusal does; the rest are kept as declined. Choosing nothing carries on."""
        job = self.load(job_id)
        if job.get("state") != "needs_you" or (job.get("needs") or {}).get("kind") != "review":
            raise Refused("this job is not waiting on its review")
        found = {f["id"]: f for f in (job.get("review") or {}).get("findings") or []}
        picked = [found[c] for c in chosen if c in found]
        job["review"]["chosen"] = [f["id"] for f in picked]
        job["review"]["declined"] = [f["id"] for f in found.values() if f not in picked]
        store.audit(actor, "review_addressed", job=job_id, chosen=job["review"]["chosen"],
                    declined=job["review"]["declined"], note=note[:500])
        if not picked and not note.strip():
            heard(job, actor, "review", "carried on without changes from the review", note)
            job["reviewed"] = True
            return self.move(job, "ship", needs=None)
        heard(job, actor, "review", f"sent {len(picked)} review finding(s) back to the build", note)
        job["reviewed"] = True
        feedback = "The requester chose these review findings for you to address:\n\n" + "\n".join(
            f"- {f['text']}" for f in picked) + (f"\n\nThey add: {note.strip()}" if note.strip() else "")
        fixed(job, "review", feedback, by=actor)
        job["revise"] = {"from": "review", "feedback": feedback[:12000], "back_to": "checks"}
        return self.move(job, "implement", needs=None)

    def decide(self, actor: str, job_id: str, action: str, note: str = "") -> dict:
        """The actions offered on a stuck, review or preview job."""
        choices = {"retry": self.decide_retry, "retry_prepare": self.decide_retry_prepare,
                   "ship_anyway": self.decide_ship_anyway, "revise": self.decide_revise,
                   "rework": self.decide_revise, "extend": self.decide_extend,
                   "revive": self.decide_revive, "merge": self.decide_merge,
                   "allow_once": self.decide_allow_once}
        job = self.load(job_id)
        store.audit(actor, action, job=job_id, note=note[:500])
        if action == "stop":
            return self.stop(actor, job_id)
        if action not in choices:
            raise Refused(f"unknown action {action!r}")

# --- oversight: who answers a checkpoint (oversight.py) ---

    def oversee(self, job: dict) -> int:
        """A checkpoint whose hold has run out, or set to auto: oversight takes
        its default, the way a person would answer it, recorded as oversight's.
        A default it cannot take (UAT on a proof that did not pass, a merge
        whose CI is not green yet) leaves the checkpoint to a person, or tries
        again next tick for the merge."""
        now = store.now()
        needs = job.get("needs") or {}
        held = needs.get("oversight") or {}
        if job.get("state") == "needs_you" and held.get("until") is not None and held["until"] <= now:
            return self.take_default(job, needs["kind"], held)
        merge = job.get("merge_oversight") or {}
        if (job.get("state") == "waiting" and job.get("stage") == "preview" and merge.get("until") is not None
                and merge["until"] <= now and (job.get("signoff") or {}).get("sha") == job.get("pushed_sha")):
            try:
                self.decide_merge(job, "oversight", "merge", "")
            except Refused:
                return 0                      # CI not green yet: asked again next tick
            self.oversaw(job, "merge", merge)
            return 1
        return 0

    def take_default(self, job: dict, kind: str, held: dict) -> int:
        actor, job_id = "oversight", job["id"]
        try:
            if kind == "questions":
                self.answer_questions(actor, job_id, {})
            elif kind == "approve":
                self.approve(actor, job_id, "approve")
            elif kind == "checks":
                self.choose_checks(actor, job_id, [s["id"] for d in job.get("definitions") or [] for s in d["scenarios"]])
            elif kind == "refused":
                refusals = (job.get("needs") or {}).get("refusals") or []
                self.decide(actor, job_id, "retry", "Retried by oversight. Keep to what was refused: "
                            + "; ".join(f"{r.get('constraint')}: {r.get('reason')}" for r in refusals)[:2000])
            elif kind == "refactor":
                self.choose_refactor(actor, job_id, [])
            elif kind == "review":
                self.address_review(actor, job_id, [])
            elif kind == "uat":
                if ((job.get("proof") or {}).get("verdict") or "") != "yes":
                    raise Refused("the proof did not pass, so UAT is a person's")
                self.sign_off(actor, job_id, True, "Passed by oversight: the proof passed.")
            else:
                return 0
        except Refused as exc:
            # Left to a person, said once on the job.
        self.need(current, "stuck", f"Something went wrong outside the work itself during "
                                    f"{stage}:\n\n{error[:1500]}", ["retry", "stop"])

    # --- bookkeeping ---

    def note(self, job: dict, line: str) -> None:
        store.log(job["id"], line)

    def move(self, job: dict, stage: str, state: str = "ready", **fields) -> dict:
        needs = fields.get("needs")
        if state == "needs_you" and isinstance(needs, dict) and needs.get("kind") in oversight.CHECKPOINTS:
            # Who answers this checkpoint: a person, or oversight after a hold, or now.
            found = oversight.policy(job.get("repo", ""), needs["kind"])
            needs["oversight"] = {**found, "until": oversight.due(found, store.now())}
        if stage != job.get("stage"):
            job.setdefault("history", []).append({"stage": stage, "at": store.now()})
            # A stage left behind starts its retries afresh if the job comes back to it.
            job.get("turn_retries", {}).pop(job.get("stage"), None)
        job.update({"stage": stage, "state": state, **fields})
        if state in FINISHED:
            job["finished"] = store.now()
    def autofix(self, job: dict, stage: str, results: list[dict], declared: list[dict], rerun=None) -> list[dict]:
        """A failed check or gate that declares a `fix:` (usually the tool's own
        fix flag: `pint`, `eslint --fix`, `prettier --write`) is fixed by that

        """A person traces a bug to a change that landed: an escape, learned from."""
        job = self.load(job_id)

        """Merged or closed ends the job; a CI failure starts a fix; idleness
        tears the preview down and leaves the PR open."""
        state = forge.pr_state(job)
        if state == "MERGED":
            # Merged on GitHub rather than here: the deploy is still watched.
            self.note(job, "merged on GitHub; watching the deploy")
            if (job.get("signoff") or {}).get("sha") != job.get("pushed_sha"):

                # it is put on the record.

                            requester=job.get("requester", ""))

            self.move(job, "preview", "closed")
            return "closed"

def phase(name: str, overrides: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """One stage's settings: defaults, then the phase, then the job's overrides.

    `overrides` is what the app sends — `{harness, model}` per job, or per
    phase under `phases:` — and it is the only thing here that is not a file.
    It may change the harness and the model; it may not change the tools, which
    are what keeps a check from repairing what it checks.
    """
    settings = read("phases")
    block = {**(settings.get("defaults") or {}), **((settings.get("phases") or {}).get(name) or {})}
    block.update(chosen(name, overrides or {}))
    block.setdefault("harness", "claude")
    denied = list(block.get("disallowed_tools") or []) + list(block.get("disallowed_tools_extra") or [])
    block["disallowed_tools"] = denied
    block.pop("disallowed_tools_extra", None)
    block["read_only"] = bool(block.get("read_only")) or any(
        tool.endswith("sprite__code__write") for tool in denied)
    return {"phase": name, **block}
